_comment: Per-artist primary genre, used by build_index.py.
WHY THIS EXISTS: the FLAC tags in this library mostly lack a genre, or
carry messy comma-lists, so the device's Genres menu came out 96%
'unknown'. This maps each artist to ONE clean genre; the build applies it
when the tag is empty or is a multi-value comma-list, and otherwise keeps
The key is the folder-derived artist, matched EXACTLY (album folders are
named 'Artist - Album'), so it must match the folder spelling rather than
This used to be a dict literal inside build_index.py, which meant every
new artist was a code edit to a tool. It is data; it lives in a data file.
Point elsewhere with --genre-map, or pass --genre-map '' to use tag
